description: Java entity class representing a Note in a note-taking application, including JPA annotations for database mapping and entity lifecycle callback methods.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: JPA entity class for Note, mapped to 'notes' table with indexes on 'title' and 'updated_at'. Contains properties for id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt, with appropriate lifecycle callbacks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback method called before persisting a new Note, sets createdAt and updatedAt to current timestamp.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback method called before updating an existing Note, updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the note.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.
